THE NORTH-CHINA SUNDAY NEWS, AUGUST 7, 1932
D3936

ATTACK ON A
NEWSPAPER

Communist Riot Against
White Russians

NOVEL OUTBREAK

Affair Last Night on
Avenue Joffre

Breaking away from their usual type of demonstrations, Communists last night branched out in a new direction by making an attack on local White Russians which manifested itself in throwing pamphlets and breaking the office windows of the "Shanghai Zarya" a local Russian newspaper, in Avenue Joffre just to the west of Rue Pere Robert.

The pamphlets attack the local White Russians as strike-breakers in Shanghai, as helpers of the Japanese in their adventures in the north, and as people who are trying to spread a "White Terror" amongst the Chinese as opponents of Soviet Russia. The pamphlets call on the populace to arise and kill the White Russians. They are dated August 5, the anniversary of the death of Lenin.

Little Damage Done

Actually little damage was done apart from the breaking of the two big glass windows of the newspaper office at 551 Avenue Joffre, while three arrests were made of Chinese, who are now in the hands of the French Police.

The affair occurred at 8 p.m. A black limousine car drove up Avenue Joffre from the east, stopped outside the "Zarya" office, and a number of pamphlets was thrown from the car on to the roadway. Then the car drove off, as suddenly as it had arrived, and nobody apparently noticed its number.

A reporter of the "Zarya" was told what had happened, and slipped out and secured a few copies of the pamphlet, which he took upstairs to translate from the Chinese. Then he heard a noise outside, followed by the crashing of glass.

Five minutes after the pamphlets had been scattered a group of working class Chinese had appeared in front of the office and, uttering a few cries, had broken the windows of the office with bottles and stones. Then they attempted to disperse in a westerly direction.

Three Arrests Made

However, a Russian fireman of the French Fire Brigade, by the name of Dalaloff, who was off duty and out for a walk but in uniform, seized one of the men who, allegedly, had taken part in the attack, and took him into the newspaper office. The Chinese, dressed in cheap blue clothes, was bleeding profusely about the head. A minute or two later two Chinese constables of the French Police came into the office, and insisted on arresting the fireman when the Chinese protested his innocence, and in the end both were taken to Central Police Station du Rue Stanislas Chevalier.

Two other Chinese were arrested by a member of the "Zarya" staff who followed them into an adjoining terrace, and it is alleged that they were subsequently recognised by a Russian member of the paper's printing department as having taken part in the attack. The Russian fireman was released immediately he reached the police station while all three Chinese were held. One is stated to be a ricsha coolie who was enjoying a holiday, while the others allege that they are fitters in the employ of the Auto Palace Co., a statement which is to be investigated this morning. It is believed that those who took part in the attack were people paid by the Communists to carry out.

Extra police were on guard in the vicinity of the "Zarya" offices last night, but all remained quiet.

A translation of the pamphlets is as follows:

Down with the White Russians!
Destroy the offices of the White Russian newspaper!
Fellow workers! Students! And all the Proletariat!

Several strikes organised by the workers of the International Settlement omnibus company, as well as strikes started by workers of the Telephone Company and the French Tramway Company, have been broken by White Russian "work-thieves." These last have assisted the Japanese troops in the occupation of the North-Eastern Provinces and of Jehol. The White Russians used by the Japanese, maybe as troops, maybe as police or detectives, have oppressed the masses of the three North Eastern Provinces. The White Russians are no other than running dogs of the Imperialists who have the intention of dismembering China. The Imperialists wish to destroy the Soviet States of workers and peasants. On one side the White Russians have organised their protection groups, on the other they are commencing to permeate Siberia in order to cause trouble there.

The White Russians who are oppressing the masses of the people, peasants and workers, are the advance guards of the Imperialists who are struggling against the red armies.

Comrades, Workers, Students and all the Proletariat!

The Russian newspaper has each day put out false rumours which attack the Soviets and spread the White Terror amongst the Chinese populace. The White Russians, enemies of the workers, peasants and the Chinese populace, and of the whole world, are systematically following up their object of opposing the struggle in favour of the revolution of the Chinese and of the Soviets.

Let us arise and kill the White Russians!
Let us destroy the offices of the White Russian newspaper!
Let us support the Soviets and the red armies!
Let us overturn the rule of the Imperialists and of the Kuomintang!
Let us destroy the White Terror!
(CHINESE BRANCH OF THE INTERNATIONAL)
August 5, 1932.

《华北星期新闻》，1932年8月7日
D3936

袭击一家
报纸

共产党人暴动反对
白俄

新型爆发

昨晚在霞飞路发生的事件

共产党人昨晚摆脱了他们通常的示威方式，开辟了一个新的方向，即袭击当地的白俄。这一行动表现为向位于霞飞路、佩雷·罗伯特路（Rue Pere Robert）以西的当地俄文报纸《上海柴拉报》（Shanghai Zarya）办公室投掷传单并砸碎其窗户。

传单指责当地白俄是上海的罢工破坏者，是日本人在北方冒险活动的帮凶，也是试图在中国人中散布“白色恐怖”的苏联俄罗斯反对者。传单号召民众起来杀死白俄。传单日期为8月5日，即列宁逝世周年纪念日。

损失轻微

除了霞飞路551号报社办公室的两扇大玻璃窗被砸碎外，实际造成的损失很小。三名中国人被捕，目前由法国警察羁押。

事件发生在晚上8点。一辆黑色豪华轿车从东面沿霞飞路驶来，停在《柴拉报》办公室外，有人从车上向路面抛撒了大量传单。随后，该车像来时一样突然驶离，显然无人注意到其车牌号码。

《柴拉报》的一名记者得知情况后，溜出去捡了几份传单，拿到楼上进行中文翻译。随后他听到外面传来一阵噪音，紧接着是玻璃破碎的声音。

传单散发五分钟后，一群中国工人阶级出现在办公室前，喊叫几声后，用瓶子和石头砸碎了办公室的窗户。随后他们试图向西分散逃离。

三人被捕

然而，一名名叫达拉洛夫（Dalaloff）的法国消防队俄国消防员，当时虽休假外出散步但身着制服，抓获了一名据称参与袭击的男子，并将其带入报社办公室。这名身穿廉价蓝布衣服的中国人头部的血流不止。一两分钟后，两名法国警察局的华捕进入办公室，在该中国人辩称无辜时，坚持要逮捕该消防员，最终两人均被带往士达高拿路（Rue Stanislas Chevalier）中央巡捕房。

另外两名中国人被一名《柴拉报》职员跟踪至相邻的露台后逮捕，据称报社印刷部的一名俄籍员工随后认出他们参与了袭击。俄国消防员一到警察局即被释放，而三名中国人则被拘留。据称其中一人是一名正在休假的黄包车夫，另外两人声称他们是汽车宫公司（Auto Palace Co.）雇佣的装配工，此说法将于今晨进行调查。据信，参与袭击者是受共产党人指使并付费行事的人员。

昨晚，《柴拉报》办公室附近增派了警力守卫，但一切保持平静。

传单译文如下：

打倒白俄！
捣毁白俄报纸办公室！
工友们！学生们！以及所有无产者！

由国际公共租界巴士公司工人组织的几次罢工，以及电话公司和法商电车公司工人发起的罢工，均被白俄“偷窃工作的人”所破坏。这些白俄协助日军占领东北各省及热河。被日本人利用的白俄，无论是作为士兵、警察还是侦探，都压迫着东北三省的大众。白俄不过是意图肢解中国的帝国主义的走狗。帝国主义企图摧毁工农苏维埃国家。一方面，白俄组织了他们的保护团体；另一方面，他们开始渗透西伯利亚，以便在那里制造麻烦。

压迫农民和工人群众大众的白俄，是与红军作战的帝国主义者的先锋。

同志们，工人、学生和所有无产者！

这家俄文报纸每天都发布攻击苏维埃并在中国人民中散布白色恐怖的谣言。白俄是工人、农民、中国人民乃至全世界人民的敌人，他们系统地推行其反对支持中国革命和苏维埃斗争的目标。

让我们起来杀死白俄！
让我们捣毁白俄报纸的办公室！
让我们支持苏维埃和红军！
让我们推翻帝国主义和国民党的统治！
让我们摧毁白色恐怖！
（国际〔救济〕会中国分会）
1932年8月5日。

Date August 12, 1932.

REPORT

Subject (in full) Attack on the "Shanghai Zaria" on August 7, 1932.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by [签名]

With reference to the attached article from the North China Sunday Post dated August 7, 1932 on the subject "Attack on a Newspaper" inquiries show that the particulars of the attack as described in the attached article are correct also the translation of pamphlets thrown. The names of three arrested persons in connection with the outrage are (1) Wang Ah Ching (汪阿慶), 47 years of age, employee of Auto Palace Co., (2) Lu Ah Pang (陸阿邦), age 36, employee of Auto Palace Co. and (3) Tang Hsiang Chen (唐祥順), age 28, ricksha coolie.

During an interview with the responsible employees of the "Shanghai Zaria" it was ascertained that the attack was absolutely unexpected, and that all the Chinese staff of the newspaper are loyal and quiet.

During the Spring and Autumn of 1931 two strikes of Chinese compositors took place. The first strike was without any obvious reason and during that time some of workers were members of the printers trade union. Those who participated in the strike were ultimately dismissed. The second strike arose owing to economical reasons. All those strikers were also dismissed. At present among the compositors there are no known members of any trade union. The owners representatives Mr. V.A. Tenlvakoff and A. Weiss do not throw any blame on the Chinese staff for the attack on the 7th instant.

The case against the abovementioned three persons have been remanded sine die.

（印：ELIE / 9 / C.S.B / Officer i/c Special Branch. / 13.8.32）

g tcheremshansky

日期 1932年8月12日。

报告

主题（全称） 1932年8月7日对《上海柴拉报》的袭击。

由 D.S. Tcheremshansky 制作。经由 [签名] 转发

关于附上的1932年8月7日《华北星期邮报》上题为“袭击一家报纸”的文章，调查显示，附件文章中描述的袭击细节以及所投传单的译文均属实。与此暴行有关的三名被捕人员姓名为：(1) 汪阿慶（Wang Ah Ching），47岁，汽车宫公司雇员；(2) 陸阿邦（Lu Ah Pang），36岁，汽车宫公司雇员；(3) 唐祥順（Tang Hsiang Chen），28岁，黄包车夫。

在与《上海柴拉报》负责员工的面谈中获悉，此次袭击完全出乎意料，且该报所有华籍员工均忠诚且安分。

1931年春秋两季，曾发生两次华籍排字工人罢工。第一次罢工没有任何明显理由，期间部分工人是印刷工会的成员。参与罢工者最终被解雇。第二次罢工是由于经济原因引起的。所有罢工者也都被解雇。目前，排字工人中没有已知的任何工会成员。业主代表 V.A. Tenlvakoff 先生和 A. Weiss 先生并未将本月7日的袭击归咎于华籍员工。

对上述三人的案件已被无限期延期审理。

（印：ELIE / 9 / C.S.B / 特别支部主管警官。/ 1932年8月13日）

g tcheremshansky
D. S.

Extract of Daily Intelligence Report dated 8/8/32

Communist Activity - attack on Russian Newspaper
Office in French Concession

During the evening of August 6, a bundle of communist
handbills addressed to labourers and students urging them to
overthrow White Russians and their newspaper offices were
thrown on to the footpath outside the office of the "Shanghai
Zaria", No.51 Avenue Joffre by the occupants of a motor car,
number unknown. Shortly after this incident, some twelve
Chinese of the coolie class, armed with stones and empty
bottles, arrived on the scene and commenced smashing the
windows of the newspaper office. The demonstrators were
dispersed by the French Police who succeeded in arresting
three of their number.

1932年8月8日每日情报报告摘录

共产党活动 - 袭击法租界内的俄文报纸
办公室

8月6日晚，一辆汽车（车牌号不详）的乘客向霞飞路51号《上海柴拉报》办公室外的人行道上投掷了一捆致劳工和学生、敦促他们推翻白俄及其报纸办公室的共产党传单。此后不久，约十二名苦力阶层的中国人手持石块和空瓶到达现场，开始砸碎报社办公室的窗户。示威者被法国警察驱散，警方成功逮捕了其中的三人。

A bas les Russes blancs ! Détruisez les locaux de la rédaction du journal
Russe blanc !

Camarades ouvriers, étudiants et tous les prolétaires !

La grève déclenchée par les ouvriers de la Compagnie d' Autobus de la
Concession Internationale, ainsi que celles déclenchées par les ouvriers de
la Cie de Téléphones et par les ouvriers de la Compagnie Française de tram-
ways, ont été entravées par les Russes blancs, ouvriers-voleurs. Ces Russes
ont aidé les troupes japonaises dans l'occupation des provinces du Nord-Est
et du Jéhol. Les Russes blancs, employés par les japonais soit comme soldats
soit comme policiers et détectives, oppriment les masses populaires des 3
provinces du Nord-Est. Les Russes blancs ne sont que les chiens des impéria-
listes qui ont l'intention de démembrer la Chine. Les impérialistes veulent
anéantir les Soviets pays des ouvriers et paysans. Les Russes blancs ont
organisé des groupes de choc pour envahir la Sibérie en vue d'y causer des
troubles.

Les Russes blancs qui oppriment les masses paysannes et ouvrières, sont
l'avant-garde des impérialistes qui luttent contre les Armées Rouges.

Camarades ouvriers, étudiants et tous les prolétaires!

Les journaux russes ont répandu chaque jour de faux bruits en attaquant
les Soviets et en demandant le renforcement de la terreur blanche contre
les masses populaires chinoises. Les Russes blancs, ennemis des ouvriers,
des paysans et des masses populaires du monde entier, font l'impossible pour
entraver la lutte en faveur de la révolution chinoise et des Soviets.

Soulevons-nous pour abattre les Russes blancs!
Détruisons les locaux de la rédaction du journal russe!
Appuyons les Soviets et les Armées Rouges!
Renversons le régime des impérialistes et des Kouomintang!
Anéantissons la terreur blanche (Signé: Branche Chinoise du MOFR
(Secours Rouge International) 8/8/32)
pages.zh:
打倒白俄！捣毁白俄俄文报纸编辑部办公场所！

工人同志、学生及所有无产者！

由国际租界巴士公司工人发起的罢工，以及由电话公司工人和法商电车公司工人发起的罢工，均受到白俄“偷窃工作的工人”的阻碍。这些白俄协助日军占领东北各省及热河。被日本人雇用的白俄，无论是作为士兵还是作为警察和侦探，都压迫着东北三省的人民大众。白俄不过是意图肢解中国的帝国主义的走狗。帝国主义企图消灭工农苏维埃国家。白俄组织了突击小组以入侵西伯利亚，旨在在那里制造混乱。

压迫农民和工人群众大众的白俄，是与红军作战的帝国主义者的先锋。

工人同志、学生及所有无产者！

俄文报纸每天散布攻击苏维埃并要求加强对中国人民大众实行白色恐怖的谣言。白俄是工人、农民和全世界人民大众的敌人，他们竭尽全力阻碍有利于中国革命和苏维埃的斗争。

让我们奋起打倒白俄！
捣毁俄文报纸编辑部办公场所！
支持苏维埃和红军！
推翻帝国主义和国民党的政权！
消灭白色恐怖 （签名：国际红色救济会中国分会 1932年8月8日）
